body:
## Summary

This removes code with no callers, which the README listed as a known gap. There's no behavior change.

- **`agent/patient.py`:** now holds only `record_id`, which `/ask` uses to name the record the agent searches. Removed `patient_block`, `record_block`, `UnknownPatient`, the cached record loader and `RECORD_PATH`. The ownership check they held isn't needed any more: the record id now comes from the signed-in user via LangChain runtime context.
- **`schema/`:** removed `MessageRequest` and `NewConversation`. Nothing referenced them outside their own tests. The comment explaining why whitespace is stripped before the length check moved onto `NewMessage`, which relies on the same rule.
- **`tests/test_schema.py`:** now tests `NewMessage` instead of `MessageRequest`, so the schema `/ask` actually uses still has tests for blank text, whitespace stripping, the length limit and ignored extra fields. The three `user_name` tests were dropped because the field is gone.
- **README:** removed the dead-code known-gap entry, and updated the API test count from 119 to 116.

## Test plan

- [x] `ruff check`, `ruff format --check`, `pytest` (116 passed)
- [x] No remaining references to the removed names in code or docs
